gallery.aiCaption: A promotional banner split diagonally showing a ship sprite and a star map, with large text reading 'Starsector Ship Editor' and 'Sector Editor'.

The editor window displaying a ship variant with text instructions to 'Drag and Drop a .variant file into the editor window to load it.'
A projectile editing screen showing JSON data for 'harpoon_mrm' and a preview of the missile.
The editor displaying a ship variant named 'executor_Elite.variant' with numerous weapon slots labeled.
A top-down view of a large ship hull in the editor, showing internal structures and module mounts.
The 'Edit Raw Ship JSON' window open over a ship sprite, displaying code for weapon slots.
A ship variant in the editor with a long list of available weapons displayed in the center.
A pixel-art icon featuring green letters 'SF' above the word 'SHIP'.
